title: KAFKA-21156: Avoid unnecessary char[] copy in ProcessorRecordContext#residentMemorySizeEstimate
body:
Previously toCharArray() was used and it allocates a new array just to
read its length.

This PR changed it to String.length() which doesn't require additional
memory and returns the same value.

This is a minor improvement with no behavior change.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>
